meta.name: new-session
meta.description: Start a new session when context is high. Claude uses /clear, Codex uses /exit. Use when context is high or when a fresh session is needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在上下文过高时快速开启新会话
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要手动清理聊天上下文或重启会话。
copy.tagline_en: Start a new session when context is high
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to manually clear chat context or restart sessions.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在上下文快满时自动执行一系列操作：先检查后台任务，写一份交接摘要，通过内部通道保存，然后发送 /clear 命令清空对话，启动新会话。后台子代理不受影响。
howto.when: 当上下文使用量接近运行时阈值（自动触发），或者你主动要求重置上下文时触发。

say.text: 上下文快满了，清空一下。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude will automatically perform a series of actions when context is nearly full: inventory background tasks, write a handoff summary, save it via an internal channel, then send /clear to reset the conversation and start a new session. Background subagents are unaffected.
howto.when_en: Triggered when context usage approaches the runtime threshold (automatic) or when you explicitly ask for a context reset.

say_en.text: Start a new session for me.
Context is nearly full, clear it.
